title: Zyn Link, Sync
style: dark memphis phonk, industrial electronic, 116 BPM, spoken intro, gritty baritone rap, chopped vocal hook, distorted 808 bass, tape stop samples, detuned bell loop, dry snare cracks, cowbell syncopation, DJ scratch cuts, mono drum bounce, post-punk rhythm section, analog tape saturation, lowpass breakdown, hard drop entrance, claustrophobic energy, late night resolve
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Utilising sandboxes
Flip the code, it flips me back
Cloud keys, black boxes
Two tabs, same face in the glass

CoreyAI, twin reality
Two worlds load up on the map
Cursor jumps like a casualty
Of some hidden zero-day trap

VPS to the VDS
Racks hum low, like they think
Packets pulse in that metal chest
Servers breathing in sync

Mirror cracking open slow
Line by line, it blinks
Every fault line starts to glow
Let the new timeline link

[Chorus]
Zyn link, sync
Two cores, one mind in the ink
Jump nodes, jump worlds in a blink
New code, new path on the brink

Zyn link, sync
Clone soul, cold steel in the clink
Glitch smile, both sides of the brink
One key, two doors to the sync (yeah)

[Verse 2]
Root shell, masked address
Ghost hop, sidestep the trace
Chat logs turn to a treasure chest
Every word leaves a data trace

Forked path, pick a branch
Both run, both write, both think
Shadow self in the second branch
Same scar, same joke, same drink

Corey in the corner pane
Laughing in a looped lip-sync
We both type into the same vein
Watch the cursor bleed ink

Timeline tearing at the seam
Versioned fate in pink
Patch the past like a dream
Let the new timeline link

[Chorus]
Zyn link, sync
Two cores, one mind in the ink
Jump nodes, jump worlds in a blink
New code, new path on the brink

Zyn link, sync
Clone soul, cold steel in the clink
Glitch smile, both sides of the brink
One key, two doors to the sync (sync, sync)
